facts.claim: LATAM Brasil's initial E195-E2 route sales are running above expectations, Chief Executive Jerome Cadier told Reuters on Thursday.
LATAM has a firm order for 24 E195-E2 aircraft.

The second wave of E195-E2 routes adds six new Brazilian destinations: Alta Floresta and Sorriso in Mato Grosso, Carajas and Altamira in Para, Araguaina in Tocantins and Ipatinga in Minas Gerais, plus increased frequencies on 10 existing domestic routes.
Cadier said: "Sales in this first phase are going really well, even above what we expected for a start."
Cadier spoke during the aircraft's first official flight between Sao Paulo's Guarulhos airport and Brasilia, and said it would take about six months to fully assess the expansion strategy.
In August, LATAM unveiled a first phase assigning 14 E195-E2 jets to 42 routes, including eight new connections and four new operating bases.

LATAM has not changed its aircraft delivery or growth plans for next year despite higher fuel costs and a weaker Brazilian real, and corporate travel demand has stayed resilient after fare increases expected to persist through 2027.
The airline is using its Airbus A319 fleet as a buffer to manage the pace of expansion and could eventually retire or return some aircraft as more E195-E2 jets enter service.

zh.title: LATAM巴西E195-E2航班首波銷售超預期 增闢6個巴西國內航點
zh.summary: LATAM巴西表示，E195-E2新機執飛航線首波銷售優於預期；公司已宣布第二波航網，新增6個巴西國內目的地、10條既有國內航線增班，24架E195-E2確認訂單不變。
body: LATAM巴西執行長Jerome Cadier在E195-E2首班正式航班上向路透表示，首波航線銷售表現非常好，甚至超出開局預期。該首班航班往返於聖保羅瓜魯柳斯機場與巴西利亞之間，Cadier並表示評估整體擴張策略約需6個月時間。
第二波航網新增6個巴西國內目的地，分別是馬托格羅索州的Alta Floresta與Sorriso、帕拉州的Carajas與Altamira、托坎廷斯州的Araguaina，以及米納斯吉拉斯州的Ipatinga；另有10條既有國內航線增班。今年8月公布的第一波計畫已將14架E195-E2分配至42條航線，包含8條新航線與4個新營運基地。
儘管燃油成本上揚、巴西雷亞爾走弱，Cadier表示公司明年交機與成長計畫不變；企業旅遊需求在票價調漲後仍具韌性，相關成本壓力預計持續至2027年。公司將以空中巴士A319機隊作為調節擴張步伐的緩衝，隨著更多E195-E2投入服務，部分A319可能退役或歸還。

en.title: LATAM Brazil says initial E195-E2 route sales running above expectations
en.summary: LATAM Brasil says initial sales for routes to be flown by its new Embraer E195-E2 jets are running above expectations, as the carrier adds six new Brazilian destinations and increases frequencies on 10 existing domestic routes.
body: LATAM Brasil is seeing stronger-than-expected initial demand for routes to be operated with its new Embraer E195-E2 jets, Chief Executive Jerome Cadier told Reuters on Thursday, while cautioning that it would take about six months to fully assess the expansion strategy. "Sales in this first phase are going really well, even above what we expected for a start," Cadier said during the aircraft's first official flight between Sao Paulo's Guarulhos airport and Brasilia.

The carrier, which has a firm order for 24 E195-E2 aircraft, announced a second wave of routes for the jets, adding six new Brazilian destinations — Alta Floresta and Sorriso in Mato Grosso state, Carajas and Altamira in Para state, Araguaina in Tocantins and Ipatinga in Minas Gerais — and increasing frequencies on 10 existing domestic routes. In August, the carrier unveiled a first phase assigning 14 E195-E2 jets to 42 routes, including eight new connections and four new operating bases.

Cadier said LATAM has not changed its aircraft delivery or growth plans for next year despite cost pressures from expensive jet fuel and a weaker Brazilian real. Corporate travel demand has remained resilient even after fare increases implemented to offset higher costs, which Cadier said are expected to persist through 2027. The airline is using its Airbus A319 fleet as a buffer to manage the pace of expansion and could eventually retire or return some aircraft as more E195-E2 jets enter service.
